enhanced_name_6w: Prefab Modular Buildings for Commercial Use
enhanced_name_long: Prefabricated Modular Buildings for Site Offices, Labour Camps, Residential and Commercial Use

buyer_intent_queries: modular labour camp for infrastructure project

segment_contamination_dimensions: Agricultural/horticultural structure buyers (greenhouse, polyhouse, mist chamber) — buyers seeking climate-controlled growing enclosures, not habitable modular buildings; terms such as greenhouse, polyhouse, grow tunnel, and agricultural shelter are blocked.

Tensile/membrane structure buyers (tensile structures, modular tensile structure, auditorium tensile, gazebo tensile) — buyers seeking fabric/membrane canopy systems, not enclosed modular buildings; terms such as tensile, membrane canopy, and fabric structure are blocked.

Pure storage-only structure buyers (storage buildings) — buyers seeking non-habitable storage enclosures without modular room/office functionality; the term 'storage building' as a standalone descriptor is blocked.

Temporary-only structure buyers (temporary buildings) — buyers seeking short-duration non-permanent shelters distinct from relocatable modular buildings; the term 'temporary building' as a standalone descriptor is blocked to avoid conflation with the sibling MCAT.
